name: Eastern Phoebe
facts: Eastern Phoebes often perch on fences or low branches and dart out to catch flying insects.
They are one of the earliest spring migrants, returning north as soon as insects become active.
Their nests are built on ledges or under eaves, often in places close to human structures.
